name: Lunar rideshare slot
blurb: Hitch a ride with a bigger payload heading to the Moon. Cheap — but strict mass limits and you go when they go.

name: Falcon 9 (booster recovered)
blurb: The workhorse. Affordable, reliable, but limited for high-energy deep-space trips.
notes: Verified: performance curve = "Falcon 9 (Full Thrust, ASDS)", launch from CCSFS. NASA LSP Performance Query, Orbit Class = High Energy, retrieved 2026-11-15 (raw answers in data/raw/lsp/performance-query.json; re-run with scripts/data/fetch-lsp.ts). Separated spacecraft mass with the site's ground rules: 3-sigma reserves, instantaneous launch attempt, 47 in (1194 mm) adapter. The site lists this configuration only from C3 -1.5 to 10 km²/s², so the curve stops at 10 and the game treats higher launch energies as out of reach. Game-scale estimates: costM and reliability.
